basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer, Product Engineering | Full-Stack Ownership | Production Systems for Millions
basics.summary: Full-stack product engineer who owns problems end to end: research, spec, design, and ship, with a metric attached and a customer on the other side. Currently at LumApps, embedding directly with stakeholders to build production multi-agent systems on GCP that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue, reporting outcomes straight to C-level. Built and owned platform-defining systems at Beekeeper for 10M+ users: an employee referral engine that became the top revenue channel ($1.5M+), a distributed templating abstraction now powering 15% of all platform assets, and an in-house LLM pipeline that killed $337K in vendor spend in 6 weeks. 13+ years shipping across the full stack, from React/Vue frontends to Postgres-backed services, with the product judgment to decide what's worth building.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress.

Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at 25% conversion, $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, a query and write-back contract per agent, and a freshness layer that flags stale facts, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.
Designed distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90%. Powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Customers go from zero to live in minutes, not days.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live UX test for autonomous systems in the real world.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families, replacing spreadsheets and expensive advisors. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built an AI-native MVP: vision models turn inspection photos into structured records; LLM agents turn those records into marketing-ready listings.
highlights: LLM listing generator turns inspection records into multilingual, marketing-ready property listings end-to-end. One agent workflow, zero copy-paste from photo to published listing.
